output.reason: The linked PR [ev-466bcd622184] says allowing empty Nomad services "would be an opt-in feature (false by default)", so it lets routes persist when a service scales to 0 only if the operator turns it on. An environment that does nothing therefore keeps its previous behaviour. That makes this a new opt-in capability with no operational consequence, not a behaviour change that needs review. The changelog entry [ev-9b56ac76a332] lists it as an enhancement and says nothing that contradicts this.

correction.statement: Traefik 3.0.0's Nomad provider gains an opt-in option (false by default) to allow empty services, so routes persist when a service is scaled to 0; environments that do not enable it see no change.

consequence.statement: Allowing empty services is an opt-in Nomad provider feature that is false by default. An environment that does nothing keeps its previous behaviour, so there is no operational consequence.
consequence.remediation: Optional: if you need routes to Nomad services scaled to zero to persist, enable the new Nomad provider option.
